other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes aggregate statistics (such as group means, stds, mins, maxes) and frequency encodings on a concatenated dataset of both train and test data before splitting. This leaks the test set feature distributions into the training features, leading to overly optimistic validation scores and potential overfitting.

summary: The agent builds a LightGBM regressor with 5-fold cross-validation but suffers from a critical data leakage flaw. By computing group aggregations and frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets, information about the test distribution leaks into the training features. Additionally, the agent makes no explicit effort to clean the data or handle missing values, relying entirely on the model's default behaviors.
